reference.author: Mike Kasberg
reference.units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

mapping.sheet: Actual 1.60-mm mesh planes map to panel, stand and carrier. Proposed supported range 1.6–2.4 mm.
mapping.socket: Measured 4.50 × 1.70-mm rectangular source loops inform two stand sockets and 4.50-mm panel tongues. Tongue depth equals sheet. Proposed sockets 4.50+total clearance by sheet+total clearance, default 4.65 × 1.75 mm; not the exact source fit.
mapping.carrier: Original closed frame plus a crossbar and eight bed-contact runners. Proposed .4–.6-mm runner thickness and .8–1.2-mm width, not source .21–.22-mm runner heights. Ring anchors are outside tongue region; stand anchors avoid sockets.
mapping.redesign: Original plane-wave acoustic Fresnel amplitude-zone panel with blocked odd zones, four spokes, two shoulder-seated tongues and separate socketed stand. Ring boundaries use r_n=sqrt(n*lambda*f+(n*lambda/2)^2). No cat geometry, image or source mesh copied. Panel art is shallow Boolean-subtracted in a protected lower bar.
mapping.limitations: Source mesh is nonwatertight with 27 edge-adjacent components, used as measured design reference only. No repaired-source claim. 128-sided circles approximate mathematical boundaries; .001-mm modeling tolerance. Supports and thickness disturb the ideal amplitude mask; no acoustic simulation.

retrieval.method: curl with browser User-Agent; urllib without UA returned 403
